name: 501 Original Jeans
description: The original button-fly jean, cut straight through the seat and thigh with a leg that sits at the ankle without stacking. This one is a mid-weight non-stretch denim in a medium stonewash with honest whiskering and fading, so it looks broken in from day one and keeps softening with every wash. Rugged and plain in the best way, it goes with a work jacket, a grey sweatshirt or a white tee and boots.
details: Regular straight fit, sits at the waist; five-button fly
Leg opening 16 in on W32; inseam 32 in
Model is 6'1" and wears W32 L32
Machine wash cold inside out, hang dry

name: Superlow Bootcut Jeans
description: A properly low-rise jean that sits on the hips, slim through the thigh and kicking out into a bootcut flare at the hem. The light blue wash has a little stretch, faded highs on the thighs and a frayed-look hem, all very early-2000s without trying too hard. Wear it with a baby tee, a cropped zip-up and slim sneakers or pointed boots.
details: Low rise, 7.5 in front rise on W27
Slim through hip and thigh, bootcut leg; inseam 32 in
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

name: 14oz Denim Monkey Cisco Jeans (Black)
description: Kapital's Monkey Cisco is a relaxed straight jean with a cinch-back, a curved patch pocket and the label's signature hand-stitched rainbow detailing on the back. This pair is 14 oz Japanese denim dyed with sulfur black and washed down to a smoky, uneven charcoal that fades at every seam. Heavy, moody and full of character, it sits as easily with a black leather jacket as with a patched chore coat.
details: 100% cotton Japanese denim, 14 oz, sulfur-dyed black
Relaxed straight fit with cinch-back belt; button fly
Hand-stitched back pocket detailing, no two exactly alike
Expect color to bleed for the first few washes; wash separately

name: Drop Baggy Jeans
description: An extra-wide, low-slung jean that drops off the hips and pools over sneakers, cut in rigid 13 oz denim with a deep acid-wash and bleached-out knees. Oversized cargo-style back pockets and a slightly longer rise at the back keep it sitting low without slipping. Loud, baggy and very Seongsu, it wants a boxy graphic tee, a nylon jacket and chunky or slim retro sneakers.
details: Baggy fit with low rise; take your usual size and wear on the hips
Leg opening 23 in on W30; inseam 33 in
Wash cold inside out; some bleach marks vary per pair

name: Spree Straight Jeans
description: A narrow straight jean in Italian stretch-free denim, garment-dyed black and stone-washed until it turns a soft, uneven graphite. Matte black hardware, a single silver ring at the coin pocket and a long inseam meant to break and stack over boots. Moody and severe, it is built to sit under a long coat or a washed leather jacket with heavy boots.
details: Straight leg with a slightly narrow opening; inseam 34 in to stack over boots
Matte black shank button and rivets, sterling silver pocket ring
Wash cold inside out with dark colors

name: Wide Leg Jeans (Ecru)
description: A high-waisted, wide-leg jean in undyed ecru denim with clean seams, no distressing and a slightly cropped length that shows a little ankle. The rigid organic cotton softens over a few wears and keeps its sharp, column-like shape. Quiet and easy, it pairs with a navy knit, a white poplin shirt or loafers and a long wool coat.
details: High rise, wide leg; inseam 29 in (cropped)
Zip fly, five pockets, tonal stitching

name: Landon Pant
description: A loose, baggy five-pocket jean in 13.5 oz Smith denim with a wide straight leg and a low crotch that drapes over sneakers. Washed in a pale stone blue, it carries the square Carhartt WIP label on the back pocket and has the easy, slouchy shape that skaters lean on. Throw it on with a heavyweight hoodie, a Detroit jacket or a boxy tee.
details: Loose fit, wide straight leg; inseam 32 in
Zip fly, five pockets, back-pocket square label

name: Double Knee Pant
description: The workwear pant that crossed over: a straight, roomy leg in stiff 12 oz Dearborn canvas with a reinforced double layer at the knees, a hammer loop and a tool pocket on the thigh. It starts out boardy and breaks in to fade along every crease. Rugged and utilitarian, it goes with a Detroit jacket and boots on site, or a hoodie and skate shoes in town.
details: Relaxed straight fit; double-layer knee with utility pocket
Hammer loop, triple-stitched seams, zip fly
Model is 6'0" and wears W32 L32
Wash cold; expect natural fading at seams
imageQuery: carhartt wip double knee pants brown

name: Tillamook Ripstop Double-Knee Pant
description: A lighter take on the work pant, cut from a dense cotton-nylon ripstop that sheds brush and dries fast, with a double-layer knee, gusseted crotch and a deep zip cargo pocket on the right thigh. The olive is garment-dyed so it fades softly at the edges, and the ankle has a hidden drawcord to cinch over trail shoes. Tough enough for a day of clearing trail, plain enough for the city, it suits a fleece and a waxed cap.
details: 65% cotton, 35% nylon ripstop, 7.5 oz; DWR finish
Relaxed fit with gusseted crotch and double-layer knee
Zip thigh cargo pocket, hammer loop, ankle drawcords
Unisex sizing; women typically size down one
Machine wash cold, line dry; free repairs for life

name: TAKIBI Pants
description: Built for sitting close to a campfire, these relaxed trousers are made from Snow Peak's flame-resistant TAKIBI fabric, a tight cotton-aramid weave that shrugs off sparks and embers. They have a wide tapered leg, an elastic-backed waist with a belt and a deep cargo pocket, and they wash down to a soft matte khaki. Quietly technical, they look as right in town with a shell and boots as they do at camp.
details: Relaxed tapered fit, elastic back waist with webbing belt
Two side pockets, two back pockets, one cargo pocket
Unisex Japanese sizing; check the size chart
Made in China, designed in Niigata

name: Static Nylon Cargo Pants
description: A low-rise parachute cargo in crinkly nylon taffeta with oversized bellows pockets, toggle drawcords at the hem and a reflective SEOM wordmark on the back of the knee. The wide leg balloons and swishes as you walk, and the drawstring waist sits right on the hips. Loud and a bit early-2000s, it suits a baby tee or a cropped puffer and slim retro sneakers.
details: Low rise, drawstring waist with elastic back
Oversized fit with toggle hems to shape the leg

name: Sorte Pleated Wide Trousers (Linen)
description: Studio Nicholson's Sorte is a deep double-pleated trouser with a high waist and a full, wide leg that falls straight to the floor. This version is a crisp Italian linen-cotton in a pale sand, with a hook-and-bar fly and clean side-seam pockets. Relaxed, considered and entirely logo-free, it works with a boxy poplin shirt, a fine knit or a simple tee and leather slides.
details: High waist, double front pleats, wide straight leg
Hook-and-bar and zip fly; side-seam and back welt pockets
Model is 5'10" and wears XS; generous through the hip
Dry clean or hand wash cold

name: Deià Linen Drawstring Trousers
description: Loose, breezy pull-on trousers in washed Mallorcan-weight linen, with a wide drawstring waist and a long, swishy leg that catches the wind. They are softened in the wash and sun-faded to a chalky white that creases beautifully. Made for hot days and salt air, they go with a striped tee, a raffia bag and espadrilles.

name: Adicolor Classics Firebird Track Pants
description: The Firebird track pant in shiny recycled tricot, with the 3-Stripes running down each leg, a slim tapered cut and zips at the ankle. It is soft and smooth on the inside with a bit of stretch, and the black with white stripes looks straight off a 90s terrace. Sporty and retro, it pairs with the matching track top, Sambas and a plain white tee.
details: Slim tapered fit, elastic waist with drawcord
Zip side pockets and ankle zips
Machine wash cold, do not tumble dry

name: Wickford Pleated Chinos
description: A proper single-pleat chino in a dense, garment-washed cotton twill, high in the rise with a roomy thigh that tapers to a cuffed hem. The stone color has the faint chalkiness of trousers that have been around a campus for years. Crisp but easy, it goes with an oxford shirt, a cable crewneck and penny loafers.
details: Mid-high rise, single forward pleat, tapered leg
1.5 in turn-up cuff; side and button-through back pockets

name: Baggies Shorts 5"
description: The do-everything short: quick-drying recycled nylon with a DWR finish, a mesh liner and an elastic drawcord waist, so it goes from river to trail to beach bar without changing. The 5-inch inseam and bright, slightly faded colors give it its sun-bleached seventies look. Wear it with a tee and sandals for camp or a linen shirt by the sea.
details: 5 in inseam, mesh liner, elastic waist with drawcord
Two side pockets, one snap back pocket
Fair Trade Certified sewn, made in Vietnam

name: Tempo Running Shorts
description: Lightweight Dri-FIT running shorts with a 3-inch inseam, split side hems and a built-in brief, so they move with you on intervals and long runs. The white ones have a contrast trim and a small Swoosh, and they look as good with a crop tee at the track as with an oversized sweatshirt on the way to brunch. Breathable and sporty.
details: 3 in inseam, built-in brief, split side hems
Elastic waist with internal drawcord and key pocket

name: RC Shorts 5"
description: New Balance's race-day short in a soft, featherweight woven with a 5-inch inseam, brief liner and a stretch waistband with a zip back pocket for a gel or key. The grey-and-white colorway with a reflective NB logo has a clean, old-school track look. Built to run, but neat enough for a coffee after.
details: Zip back pocket, two liner pockets

name: Cala Linen Shorts
description: Easy, pull-on linen shorts with a drawstring waist, a 6-inch inseam and a soft garment-washed hand that only gets better in the sun. The faded sky blue and sand colors look like they have spent a few summers by the harbor. Wear them with a camp-collar linen shirt and espadrilles, or a striped tee and a straw hat.
details: Slant side pockets and one patch back pocket

name: Foundry Utility Shorts
description: A heavy duck-canvas work short with a 9-inch inseam, a tool pocket and hammer loop on the leg and bar-tacked stress points throughout. The tobacco brown starts stiff and breaks in to a soft, worn-in canvas that fades along every seam. Rugged and roomy, it suits a hike, a day in the workshop or a summer evening at camp with a tee and boots.
details: 9 in inseam, relaxed fit, zip fly
Tool pocket, hammer loop, bar-tacked seams
Unisex sizing; women typically size down one
Machine wash cold; free repairs for life

name: Kennebunk Pleated Mini Skirt
description: A knife-pleated mini skirt in a soft Scottish lambswool tartan of navy, green and a fine cream line, with a side zip and a narrow waistband. The pleats are stitched down at the hip so it lies flat and swings at the hem. Crisp and collegiate, it goes with an oxford shirt, a cable crewneck, knee socks and loafers.
details: Knife pleats, stitched at the hip; 16 in length on S
Side zip and button; half-lined in cupro

name: Solveig Gingham Pleated Midi Skirt
description: A full, soft-pleated midi skirt in a crisp cotton poplin gingham of green and cream, with a high smocked back waist and deep side pockets. It swishes when you walk and has a sweet, slightly old-fashioned feel. Wear it with a puff-sleeve blouse and ballet flats, or a navy cardigan and loafers.
details: High waist with smocked back; soft unpressed pleats
Midi length, 31 in on S; side pockets
Made in small runs in Portugal

name: Mitte Draped Maxi Skirt
description: A long, column maxi skirt in heavy draped viscose jersey with a bias-cut swirl at the hem and a high, wide waistband that folds over. It falls past the ankle and moves like liquid, catching the light only at the folds. Moody and dramatic, it wants a cropped leather jacket, silver rings and heavy boots.
details: Ankle-grazing to floor length; 40 in on S

name: Glitch Low-Rise Cargo Mini Skirt
description: A low-slung mini skirt in washed nylon twill with two big bellows cargo pockets, a silver-toned D-ring belt and an adjustable bungee hem. It sits on the hips and is short in that early-2000s way. Pair it with a baby tee, a cropped puffer and slim retro sneakers or chunky boots.
details: Low rise, 14 in length on S
Bellows cargo pockets, D-ring webbing belt included

name: Alfama Crochet Midi Skirt
description: An open-stitch crochet midi skirt hand-finished in soft mercerized cotton, with a scalloped hem and a slip lining you can wear or leave out. The cream yarn has a slight sheen and the pattern is a traditional Portuguese shell stitch. Soft and summery, it pairs with a linen shirt knotted at the waist, a bikini top or a fine knit tank.
details: Elasticated waist; removable cotton slip lining
Knitted and finished outside Lisbon, Portugal
